observations.assessment: Read SmartScore, PlayScore and Audiveris first measures for missing notation. PlayScore supports delayed-turn/slur families but omits lower sharps; print supplies those. SmartScore false cello slur and bar-5 tenuto not accepted. Audiveris part/measure labels differ; not used as physical authority.

Provenance confirms P006 cello rest template from PlayScore and G#5 selection from LEGATO despite PlayScore G3 alternative; direct print rejects both erroneous choices. P008 cello C2 selected SmartScore with D2 alternative in CLAUDE; print decides D2 independently.

Consulted all three released readers at P025 upper piano. PlayScore grace D5, D6 half and tie agree with print. SmartScore grace as quarter/E6 rejected. Audiveris D6 half/tie at incorrect onset3/2 rejected for timing. No source majority used.

Consulted P030–P034 readers on F-natural boundary and piano polyphony. PlayScore retains F5 tie, SmartScore resets F# after losing tie. Print confirms tie. P032 Audiveris retains both G5 tie and long slur; PlayScore splits long slur start to P033. Double arc in source favors start at P032. Readers also invent spacer rests; do not preserve them as authored rests.

Consulted all three released readers at P033–P034: lower A4 supported by print despite SmartScore B4; candidate rest rejected. PlayScore D5 grace/D6 quarter supports print. Source doubling and invented rests rejected. Audiveris fingering 1 beneath P033 D5 is not accepted automatically; no clear printed digit in full system image, preserve for close final check.

Compared released P049 piano events for all readers after print inspection: each supports D4 half onset2 and G4 final quarter, despite frozen candidate values. PlayScore grace transcription omits first F#5; three grace heads visible in enlarged print.

principle: Reader outputs and ensemble selections are fallible supporting evidence. Source print decides corrections.

continuation_system_observations.observation: Compared released P049 piano events for all readers after print inspection: each supports D4 half onset2 and G4 final quarter, despite frozen candidate values. PlayScore grace transcription omits first F#5; three grace heads visible in enlarged print. P053 violin: PlayScore supports all twelve triplet eighths; SmartScore misses triplet timing and reads D4 as C4; Audiveris truncates passage. Actual printed heads/beams and continuing triplets control. P052 bass readers support C2/C3 to B1/B2 slurs; Audiveris preserves separate member anchoring, PlayScore stacks both starts on lower member. No tie inferred.
No difficult event disagreement requiring additional raw-reader consultation; direct print comparison controls.

P070 lower staff targeted comparison: all readers support G3/B3 first half and C3 half at onset2. Audiveris/SmartScore support A3 half; PlayScore includes E3 and D3/F#3 inner quarters. None alone captures complete exact polyphony; source close crop resolves.

Compared all released violin P074–P079 claims: SmartScore supports dotted-half and dotted-eighth rhythm but omits graces; PlayScore detects some graces with inconsistent types and replaces dots with rests; Audiveris incomplete. Direct enlarged print controls repeated motif at each location. Candidate P074/P077 cello bears octave/rhythm errors not supported by print.

P083–P087 piano compared all released readers after print inspection. SmartScore and others support Eb4 half bass and real upper double stops; frozen candidate contains fabricated string copies and lost piano content. P084/P086 F#4 half supported by close print despite inconsistent G4/F#4 reader claims. No vote used.
